answer: Score every identity by how many independent paths its work reaches, then decay that score each epoch it stays idle. Last month a farm cloned 60 profiles from one template, named them all differently, and parked them a week to age. Replay caught them first: identical outputs hashed to one quartz fingerprint, and the decay curve had already hollowed their weight before the second panel looked. Rebuilding on a fresh mesa of names repeats the same paid work, which is the cost that matters.
